name: Proving Grounds: Trial of Endurance
summary: A Muramite endurance arena designed to exhaust combatants through attrition, prolonged combat cycles, and Discord‑charged fatigue.
description: The Trial of Endurance is a grueling arena where Muramite overseers test the stamina and resilience of soldiers and captives. The environment is engineered to drain strength over time: Discord fatigue fields, attrition corridors, and prolonged combat cycles. Dragorn captives are forced into extended engagements, while Muramite soldiers prove their ability to withstand exhaustion. Discord anomalies intensify as endurance wanes, punishing weakness and rewarding sustained discipline.
